note: Labels are the contract of this eval. Change them only on purpose, in a commit that says why. `history` alternates lead/agent exactly as the transcript would, so the question the script just asked is real rather than asserted. `known` is the slot state the turn starts from: the extraction re-states it constantly and `mergeSlots` ignores that, so re-stating a known value is not an error — contradicting one is. `expect` is what this message must add; anything filled beyond `known` and `expect` is invention.
